summary.text: Terry Alexander is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 59, who assumed office in 2006 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a pastor at Wayside Chapel Baptist Church and an education consultant, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Alexander earned an A.D. from Durham Business College in 1976, a B.A. from Francis Marion University in 1991 and an M.Div. from Howard University School of Divinity in 1998.

According to Ballotpedia, he worked as a managing partner of Sunrise of the Pee Dee, a career development consultant and an adjunct professor of religion at Limestone College, and has served on the Pee Dee Regional Council of Governments.
Alexander first assumed office in the South Carolina House in 2006.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Education and Public Works Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
